„

Involvement

Act Two

Moonrise Towers

Niram is in the Moonrise Towers throne room, standing guard over a trial presided by  Ketheric Thorm. Once the trial ends, Niram moves to the eastern side of the throne room.

Defending Moonrise Towers

If the  Nightsong is freed and the Harpers launch their assault on Moonrise Towers, Niram is killed during the subsequent battle. His corpse is at the bottom of the stairs of the main door, at X: -158 Y: -130.

Notes and references

  2. ↑ Niram's  Scalpspike Helm features a set of spiked wings on the sides, which is not present on the regular helmet or on any other zealots.
